## AppGuardian Companion

A standalone app for [AppGuardian](https://mikiyan1978.github.io/sileo-repo/depictions/com.mikiyan1978.appguardian.json) — every row its Settings pane has, without opening Settings.app. Installed alongside AppGuardian automatically on first install, same Tweak+companion-app relationship SnowBoard/Activator use. Changes made here and in Settings are the exact same shared configuration, always in sync.

- Every switch, slider, and button AppGuardian's Settings pane has: Master Switch, Grid View, Kill All, Stay Foreground, Fast Freeze grace period, Notification Sound, 3D Touch Menu Customization, Action Logging, Sweep Unprotected Apps, Clear All Selections, Diagnostics, Profile Export/Import, Restart Services, Respring
- A colored leading icon on every row for fast visual scanning, matching the color each feature's Home Screen badge already uses
- Every change takes effect immediately — the same shared CFPreferences domain AppGuardian itself reads, with the same live-reload broadcast Settings uses
- Fully localized: English, 日本語, Deutsch, Français, Español, 简体中文, 한국어

Per-app protection (Kill Guard/Stay Foreground/Fast Freeze) isn't chosen here or in Settings — both deliberately leave that to each app's own Home Screen icon 3D Touch menu, the single place that already edits those lists, instead of offering a second, redundant app-picker screen.

Requires [AppGuardian](https://mikiyan1978.github.io/sileo-repo/depictions/com.mikiyan1978.appguardian.json) — this app only ever edits AppGuardian's own configuration and does nothing on its own. Removing this companion app leaves AppGuardian itself fully working; it's a one-way dependency.

## AppGuardian Companion

[AppGuardian](https://mikiyan1978.github.io/sileo-repo/depictions/com.mikiyan1978.appguardian.json)用のスタンドアローンアプリです。設定アプリを開かなくても、設定パネルの全項目をこのアプリから操作できます。SnowBoard/Activatorと同じTweak+コンパニオンアプリ構成で、初回インストール時にAppGuardian本体と同時にインストールされます。このアプリと設定アプリは全く同じ共有設定を読み書きするため、常に同期しています。

- AppGuardianの設定アプリにある全項目に対応：マスタースイッチ、グリッド表示、全kill、バックグラウンド回避、Fast Freeze猶予時間、通知音、3D Touchメニューのカスタマイズ、Action Logging、未保護アプリを一括終了、全選択をクリア、診断、プロフィールのExport/Import、サービスを再起動、Respring
- 各行に色付きアイコンを表示し、見やすく整理（ホーム画面バッジと同じ配色）
- 変更は即座に反映——AppGuardian本体が読み取るのと同じ共有CFPreferencesドメイン、同じ即時反映の仕組みを使用
- 日本語を含む7言語に対応：English, 日本語, Deutsch, Français, Español, 简体中文, 한국어
アプリごとの保護設定（Kill Guard/Stay Foreground/Fast Freeze）は、このアプリからも設定アプリからも選択できません。これらは意図的に、各アプリのホーム画面アイコンの3D Touchメニュー——既にその一覧を編集している唯一の場所——に任せており、重複するアプリ選択画面はあえて用意していません。

[AppGuardian](https://mikiyan1978.github.io/sileo-repo/depictions/com.mikiyan1978.appguardian.json)本体が必要です——このアプリはAppGuardianの設定を編集するだけで、単体では何もしません。このコンパニオンアプリだけを削除しても、AppGuardian本体は問題なく動作し続けます（依存は一方向のみ）。

## 1.1
- Full localization: English, 日本語, Deutsch, Français, Español, 简体中文, 한국어
- Added Settings.app-style colored leading icons to every row
- Fixed the app-picker screen's icons rendering at native pixel size instead of a consistent 40x40pt (a @3x icon came out roughly 3x too large)
- Fixed CFPreferences writes to AppGuardian's configuration domain being silently blocked by the app sandbox — switches/sliders now take effect
- Fixed the Fast Freeze grace period slider being frozen at a too-narrow width, and overlapping its own label
- Removed the Kill Guard/Stay Foreground app-picker screens (redundant with the Home Screen icon's own 3D Touch menu), matching the same change in AppGuardian's own Settings pane

## 1.0 (initial)
- First release: mirrors every row AppGuardian's Settings pane has (feature switches, Fast Freeze grace period, notification sound, app pickers, 3D Touch menu customization, Sweep/Clear All, Diagnostics, Restart Services, Respring, profile Export/Import)
- Installed alongside AppGuardian automatically on first install
